description.value: This is a randomized controlled study of CBT in children and adolescents with aggressive behavior, examining functional neuroimaging and electrophysiological correlates of aggression and its reduction after CBT.

spans.text: This is a randomized controlled study of CBT in 80 children and adolescents with aggressive behavior.

value: we hypothesize that reduction of aggression after CBT will engage the neural circuitry of emotion regulation.

we predict that reduction of aggression after CBT will be associated with increased activation of the dACC and vmPFC, decreased activation in the amygdala, and increased functional connectivity among these regions.
